description: Current posted wait times for Walt Disney World attractions plus SupaPark's Real Wait estimate of the actual wait, a low/high range, confidence, and a flag for "ghost" waits that are posted but not real. Refreshes every few minutes during park hours. Disneyland Resort parks (disneyland, california-adventure) are accepted; they return quality_state "unavailable" until Disneyland Resort data is connected.

park.description: Park to return waits for. Omit for all four parks.

resort.description: Resort: "wdw" (Walt Disney World, the default) or "dlr" (Disneyland Resort). A park argument, when given, decides the resort.

name: get_live_wait_times
title: Live wait times
